paragraphs.en: As pretraining scales, medical language models have advanced rapidly in clinical question answering. Their ability to achieve effective physiological control through sustained intervention still lacks systematic quantitative evaluation. Type 1 diabetes provides a concrete setting: impaired insulin secretion creates dependence on exogenous insulin, with dosing continually adjusted using information about meals, exercise, illness, and glucose measurements. We introduce DiabAgent , a research suite for agentic physiological control comprising the Agentic Physiological Control ( APC ) framework, the DiabetSim simulator, and the SweetBench benchmark. APC controls glucose through medical-device tools, using ongoing observations to infer individual states, accumulate personal experience, and choose treatment actions. We build DiabetSim to simulate different patients, events, and device conditions for scalable virtual testing and training. Using DiabetSim , we construct SweetBench by instantiating 32 scenario designs as 212 glucose-control tasks. With Claude Opus 5.5 and a fixed decision interval of one hour, APC achieves a COGI of 73.5, compared with 71.2 for the open-source closed-loop baseline OpenAPS. Ablations further show that individual adaptation and contextual information improve glucose control. Combining high-frequency rule-based control with lower-frequency agent decisions shows potential for balancing control performance and computational cost. Our work provides a framework, simulator, and evaluation foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control.
paragraphs.zh: 随着预训练规模的扩大，医学语言模型在临床问答方面取得了快速进展。 但它们通过持续干预实现有效生理控制的能力仍缺乏系统的定量评估。 1型糖尿病提供了一个具体场景：胰岛素分泌受损导致对外源性胰岛素的依赖，且剂量需根据进餐、运动、疾病和血糖测量等信息不断调整。 我们提出 DiabAgent，这是一个用于智能体化生理控制的研究套件，包括智能体化生理控制（APC）框架、DiabetSim 模拟器和 SweetBench 基准测试。 APC 通过医疗器械工具控制血糖，利用持续的观测来推断个体状态、积累个人经验并选择治疗动作。 我们构建 DiabetSim 来模拟不同的患者、事件和设备状况，以支持可扩展的虚拟测试与训练。 借助 DiabetSim，我们将 32 种场景设计实例化为 212 个血糖控制任务，构建了 SweetBench。 使用 Claude Opus 5.5 和一小时的固定决策间隔，APC 的 COGI 达到 73.5，而开源闭环基线 OpenAPS 为 71.2。 消融实验进一步表明，个体适应和情境信息能够改善血糖控制。 将高频的基于规则的控制与较低频率的智能体决策相结合，在平衡控制性能与计算成本方面展现出潜力。 我们的工作为智能体参与人类生理控制提供了框架、模拟器和评估基础。

paragraphs.en: As pretraining scales, medical language models have advanced rapidly in clinical question answering and treatment advice ( Singhal et al., 2023 ; Arora et al., 2025 ) . Agents combine language models with tools, memory, and environment feedback to execute multi-step tasks ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . They complete long tasks in software and service environments and reuse experience in later decisions ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . Medical agents conduct diagnostic dialogue, analyze treatment options, and operate electronic health records ( Tu et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Evaluation of these tasks primarily concerns responses or information operations. Assessing whether language models can control physiology through sustained intervention requires systematic evaluation of the resulting physiological trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Type 1 diabetes provides a concrete setting for this problem. People with type 1 diabetes have impaired insulin secretion and depend on exogenous insulin for glucose control. Dosing needs vary with meals, exercise, illness, and individual states, while insulin continues to act for hours, linking current decisions to earlier treatment and subsequent events ( Holt et al., 2021 ; Riddell et al., 2017 ) . Differences between people, daily changes in insulin needs, and delayed, noisy, or missing glucose measurements make control a long-horizon task requiring ongoing state inference, treatment adjustment, and feedback tracking. Automated insulin delivery and learned closed-loop controllers have advanced glucose control ( Brown et al., 2019 ; Sherr et al., 2022 ; Hettiarachchi et al., 2024 ; Sarkar, 2026 ) . Existing dynamical models and evaluation metrics also provide a basis for simulating glucose dynamics and assessing control outcomes ( Deichmann et al., 2023 ; Battelino et al., 2019 ) . Together, these conditions support systematic study of how agents combine contextual information, personal experience, and device tools for sustained physiological control.
paragraphs.zh: 1型糖尿病为这一问题提供了一个具体的场景。 1型糖尿病患者的胰岛素分泌受损，需要依赖外源性胰岛素来控制血糖。 剂量需求随进餐、运动、疾病和个体状态而变化，而胰岛素会持续作用数小时，使当前决策与先前的治疗及后续事件相关联（Holt et al., 2021; Riddell et al., 2017）。 个体之间的差异、胰岛素需求的每日变化，以及延迟、含噪或缺失的血糖测量，使控制成为一项长期任务，需要持续的状态推断、治疗调整和反馈跟踪。 自动胰岛素输注和基于学习的闭环控制器已经推进了血糖控制（Brown et al., 2019; Sherr et al., 2022; Hettiarachchi et al., 2024; Sarkar, 2026）。 现有的动力学模型和评估指标也为模拟血糖动力学和评估控制结果提供了基础（Deichmann et al., 2023; Battelino et al., 2019）。 综合来看，这些条件为系统研究智能体如何结合情境信息、个人经验和设备工具以实现持续的生理控制提供了支持。

paragraphs.en: Rule-based closed-loop control typically organizes dosing around structured glucose measurements, insulin records, carbohydrate estimates, and prescribed therapy parameters ( OpenAPS community, 2026 ) . Using descriptions of a changed meal plan, illness recovery, or a device problem requires mapping them to predefined inputs and response rules. This mapping constrains how the controller can use cues in free-text context and personal treatment notes. Interacting rare events and individual differences also require judging which cues explain current glucose changes and subsequent dosing needs ( Holt et al., 2021 ) . Can an agent interpret this context and personal experience, act through medical-device tools, and translate that understanding into better physiological control? This question motivates the Agentic Physiological Control ( APC ) framework that we study in DiabAgent .
paragraphs.zh: 基于规则的闭环控制通常围绕结构化的血糖测量、胰岛素记录、碳水化合物估算以及处方的治疗参数来组织给药（OpenAPS 社区，2026）。 使用关于饮食计划改变、疾病康复或设备故障的描述，需要将它们映射到预定义的输入和响应规则上。 这种映射限制了控制器利用自由文本上下文和个人治疗笔记中线索的方式。 相互作用的罕见事件和个体差异还需要判断哪些线索能够解释当前的血糖变化以及后续的给药需求（Holt 等，2021）。 智能体能否解读这类上下文和个人经验，通过医疗器械工具采取行动，并将这种理解转化为更好的生理控制？ 这一问题促使我们提出了在 DiabAgent 中研究的智能体化生理控制（APC）框架。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate APC with five models. With Claude Opus 5.5, it achieves a COGI of 73.5, compared with 71.2 for OpenAPS. Further experiments show that records and review support cross-day improvement without weight updates, and that added context can improve control more than increasing agent decision frequency in the tested cases. More frequent agent calls also increase computation. CL-on/off case studies indicate the potential of combining frequent background glucose regulation with less frequent agent decisions that integrate observations and personal experience.

paragraphs.en: APC treats treatment as a control problem in which the controller is an agent and the sensors and actuators are medical devices.
paragraphs.zh: APC 将治疗视为一个控制问题，其中控制器是一个智能体，传感器和执行器是医疗设备。

paragraphs.en: An APC problem consists of a physiological system with hidden state, medical devices that measure and act on it, reports from the person, and a score on the physiological trajectory. An APC agent repeatedly observes, acts through the devices, and decides when to reassess, so as to maximize the expected score.

paragraphs.en: An APC agent has four components that close this loop (Figure 2 ). Decision making selects an intervention, a measurement, or waiting, and states its rationale. Device tools execute the operation and return readings and delivery logs. Monitoring watches incoming observations and returns control to the agent when its chosen waiting interval ends or a specified condition occurs. paragraphs.en: The design addresses three requirements. Interpretability makes the basis of an action traceable through decision rules or an explicit rationale. Information integration combines glucose measurements, natural-language and multimodal reports, and personal history to infer the hidden state and select interventions. Long-tail event adaptation uses contextual reports to adjust treatment when events overlap or fall outside predefined response categories.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计满足了三项需求。 可解释性使行动的依据可通过决策规则或明确的理由进行追溯。 信息整合将血糖测量数据、自然语言与多模态报告以及个人病史结合起来，以推断隐藏状态并选择干预措施。 长尾事件适配利用情境报告，在事件重叠或超出预定义响应类别时调整治疗方案。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate APC for glucose control in type 1 diabetes, combining device observations with contextual reports and personal experience. The state comprises glucose, insulin still acting, carbohydrate absorption, and device status; meals, activity, and illness perturb this state. APC observes sensor or meter readings, delivery logs and alarms, and reports of meals, activity, and device problems. Its actions are insulin delivery through boluses, temporary basal rates, or injections, measurement requests such as scans and fingersticks, device management such as cancellation, suspension, and resumption, and waiting. The score combines time in range, hypoglycemia, and variability of true glucose (Section 4.2 ; Battelino et al., 2019 ). The idealized reference is a healthy pancreas, which regulates glucose continuously without devices or reports.
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对1型糖尿病的血糖控制实例化APC，将设备观测与情境报告及个人经验相结合。 状态包括血糖、仍在起作用的胰岛素、碳水化合物吸收情况以及设备状态；进食、运动和疾病会扰动该状态。 APC观测传感器或血糖仪读数、输注记录与警报，以及关于进食、运动和设备问题的报告。 其动作包括通过大剂量、临时基础速率或注射进行的胰岛素输注、扫描和指尖采血等测量请求、取消、暂停和恢复等设备管理操作，以及等待。 评分结合了目标范围内时间、低血糖以及真实血糖的变异性（第4.2节；Battelino等，2019）。 理想化的参照是健康的胰腺，它无需设备或报告即可持续调节血糖。

paragraphs.en: At each decision, APC reviews recent readings, insulin still acting, reported events, and its personal record, and estimates where glucose is heading. It then chooses one operation supported by the current devices and states why. The same decision fixes when to look again and which events, such as a new reading, a reported meal, or an alarm, should wake it earlier. Monitoring holds control until one of these occurs.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次决策时，APC 会审查最近的读数、仍在起效的胰岛素、报告的事件以及其个人记录，并估计血糖的走向。 然后它选择当前设备支持的一种操作，并说明理由。 同一决策还会确定下次查看的时间，以及哪些事件（例如新读数、报告的进餐或警报）应当提前唤醒它。 监控会保持控制，直到其中之一发生为止。

paragraphs.en: DiabetSim is a configurable environment for virtual testing of glucose-control agents. It comprises a physiological engine, monitoring and delivery device models, and an instance generator. Together, these components simulate individual glucose responses, everyday events, and device-mediated interventions. Agents observe device readings and event reports; the evaluator records the underlying glucose trajectory for scoring.
paragraphs.zh: DiabetSim 是一个可配置的环境，用于对血糖控制智能体进行虚拟测试。 它包含一个生理引擎、监测与输注设备模型，以及一个实例生成器。 这些组件共同模拟个体的血糖反应、日常事件以及经由设备实施的干预。 智能体观察设备读数和事件报告；评估器记录潜在的血糖轨迹用于评分。

paragraphs.en: The engine models glucose–insulin dynamics using Deichmann et al. (2023) , including the effects of physical activity. Individual parameters θ \theta specify insulin sensitivity and body-mass-dependent responses. The simulator includes eight physiological types with different body masses and dawn phenomena, together with day-to-day variation in insulin sensitivity. Meals introduce carbohydrate absorption, while activity and illness modify subsequent physiological responses. The simulator configures therapy settings separately from physiological parameters, allowing prescribed treatment to differ from an individual’s insulin requirements. An event-driven scheduler advances physiological and device states as external events occur and treatment actions execute.
paragraphs.zh: 该引擎采用 Deichmann 等人 （2023）的方法建模葡萄糖–胰岛素动力学，并纳入了体力活动的影响。 个体参数 θ \theta 用于刻画胰岛素敏感性和依赖于体重的反应。 该模拟器包含八种生理类型，具有不同的体重和黎明现象，并包含胰岛素敏感性的日间波动。 进食引入碳水化合物的吸收，而活动和疾病会改变随后的生理反应。 该模拟器将治疗方案设置与生理参数分开配置，使处方的治疗可以不同于个体的胰岛素需求。 事件驱动的调度器在外部事件发生和治疗动作执行时推进生理状态与设备状态。

paragraphs.en: Observation. Monitoring devices determine the measurements available to the agent. The simulator includes eight sensor models and six glucose-meter models, parameterized by published accuracy specifications ( Vettoretti et al., 2019 ; International Organization for Standardization, 2013 ) . Real-time continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) produce readings every five minutes; flash sensors return readings upon scanning, and meters upon fingerstick measurement. The models represent sensor warm-up, data gaps, and compression artifacts. Scans and fingerstick measurements are agent actions, making observation timing part of the control policy. A reporting configuration ρ \rho additionally specifies the availability, timing, and accuracy of reports about meals, activity, and other events.

paragraphs.en: Action set. Delivery devices determine the available treatment operations and their constraints. The simulator includes five pump models, 10 pen models, and 10 insulin formulations. paragraphs.en: An instance specifies patient parameters, device and reporting configurations, the event schedule, initial physiological and device states, pre-episode history, evaluation horizon, and random seed. paragraphs.en: Within DiabetSim ’s configurable environment space, SweetBench defines 32 scenario designs in seven groups. These cover meal timing and absorption, residual insulin, exercise, changing insulin needs, pump under-delivery, sensor errors, and illness recovery (Table 2 ). Each design specifies an event combination and its temporal relationships. Examples include a cancelled meal after a pre-meal bolus followed by activity, or silent under-delivery with upward sensor drift. We instantiate each design for four to eight simulated individuals, adapting event timing and magnitude to each person, to obtain 212 tasks. Appendix A , Table 8 , lists all designs by ID, including A01 and E03.
paragraphs.zh: 在 DiabetSim 的可配置环境空间中，SweetBench 定义了七个分组共 32 种情景设计。 这些情景涵盖进餐时间与吸收、剩余胰岛素、运动、不断变化的胰岛素需求、泵输送不足、传感器误差以及疾病恢复（表 2）。 每种设计都规定了事件组合及其时间关系。 例子包括餐前大剂量注射后取消进餐并随后进行运动，或者泵无声输送不足并伴随传感器向上漂移。 我们为每种设计实例化四到八名模拟个体，并根据每个人的情况调整事件的时间与幅度，从而获得 212 个任务。 附录 A 的表 8 按编号列出了所有设计，包括 A01 和 E03。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. We evaluate all methods on the 212 tasks of SweetBench . Each 72-hour episode fixes the patient, initial state, event calendar, and random seed, and uses a simulated Dana-i pump, insulin aspart, and real-time CGM under I2. Meals and other events remain unreported. Each method acts through the same device interface using only visible measurements and records; the environment continues to evolve between decisions. The main evaluation adds no separate background HCL controller. We compute COGI and its three subscores from 864 five-minute true-glucose samples per episode, then average completed episodes with equal weight (Section 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 我们在 SweetBench 的 212 个任务上评估所有方法。 每个 72 小时回合固定患者、初始状态、事件日历和随机种子，并在 I2 下使用模拟的 Dana-i 泵、门冬胰岛素和实时 CGM。 餐食和其他事件保持未上报状态。 每个方法通过相同的设备接口行动，仅使用可见的测量值和记录；环境在两次决策之间持续演化。 主评估不添加单独的后台 HCL 控制器。 我们从每个回合 864 个五分钟真实血糖样本计算 COGI 及其三个子分数，然后对已完成的回合以相等权重取平均（第 4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Baseline Setting. We compare three controllers. Basal–Bolus (BB) follows a prescribed basal schedule and calculates meal and correction boluses from reported carbohydrates, glucose, carbohydrate ratio, insulin sensitivity, and insulin on board ( Holt et al., 2021 ; Fox et al., 2020 ) . Event-Aware Basal–Bolus (BB+Rules) augments this BB policy with predefined rules for glucose trends, reported exercise and illness, and device problems ( Riddell et al., 2017 ) . OpenAPS uses its open-source dosing core to compute temporary basal adjustments and micro-boluses from glucose feedback. All three controllers use 15-minute decision intervals and the same visible observations. Appendix C.2 specifies the formulas, rules, and OpenAPS implementation; the case studies also use OpenAPS as their reference.
paragraphs.zh: 基线设置。 我们比较三种控制器。 基础–餐时（BB）按照规定的基础剂量方案执行，并根据报告的碳水化合物、血糖、碳水化合物系数、胰岛素敏感性和体内胰岛素计算餐时大剂量和校正大剂量（Holt et al., 2021；Fox et al., 2020）。 事件感知基础–餐时（BB+Rules）在该 BB 策略的基础上，增加了针对血糖趋势、报告的运动和疾病以及设备问题的预定义规则（Riddell et al., 2017）。 OpenAPS 使用其开源给药核心，根据血糖反馈计算临时基础剂量调整和微量大剂量。 这三种控制器均使用 15 分钟的决策间隔和相同的可见观测。 附录 C.2 规定了具体的公式、规则和 OpenAPS 的实现；案例研究同样以 OpenAPS 作为参考。

paragraphs.en: We test whether personal records and end-of-day review improve control across days. On six configurations over seven days, we compare four conditions: daily record reset , which passes no personal record to the next day; cross-day record only , which retains personal records for the next day without additional end-of-day review; record + review-generated plan , which retains records and reviews the day’s treatment responses to generate a plan for subsequent control; and record + plan + execution feedback , which additionally incorporates feedback on the execution of previous plans into the review. All conditions reset the conversation daily while maintaining continuous physiology and fixed model weights.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试个人记录与每日结束时的回顾能否改善跨天的控制。 在六种配置、为期七天的实验中，我们比较四种条件：仅每日记录重置，即不向第二天传递任何个人记录；仅跨天记录，即为第二天保留个人记录但不进行额外的每日结束回顾；记录 + 回顾生成的计划，即保留记录并回顾当天的治疗反应以生成后续控制的计划；以及记录 + 计划 + 执行反馈，即在回顾中额外纳入对先前计划执行情况的反馈。 所有条件每天都会重置对话，同时保持连续的生理数据和固定的模型权重。

paragraphs.en: We compare pens and DASH with CL off or on in Slow-Meal Overlap, Stress Resolution, and Post-Illness Refeeding, testing both delivery options and cooperation with a background controller. Each configuration uses the same agent for a 72-hour run in each case. DASH-w/o CL scores approximately 6–8 points above pens, mainly through time in range and variability (Table 5 ). Turning CL on further raises COGI by 4.63 and 2.53 points in the first two cases and gives a similar score in the third, without increasing the agent’s decision frequency. The background HCL supplies frequent basal-rate adjustments, while the agent integrates observations and personal history to choose doses, carbohydrate intake, and device actions. The trajectories show how adjustable infusion follows prolonged absorption and changing insulin needs (Figure 4 ). These cases show that delivery configurations shape control performance and support the potential of high-frequency closed-loop control combined with lower-frequency agent decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在“慢餐重叠”、“应激缓解”和“病后恢复进食”三个场景中，比较了笔注射与 DASH 在关闭或开启持续学习（CL）时的表现，测试了两种给药方式以及与后台控制器的协作。 每种配置在每种情况下都使用同一个智能体进行72小时的运行。 DASH-w/o CL 的得分比笔注射高出约6–8分，主要得益于范围内时间和变异性指标（表5）。 开启 CL 后，前两种情况下的 COGI 分别进一步提高了4.63分和2.53分，第三种情况的得分相近，且没有增加智能体的决策频率。 后台 HCL 提供频繁的基础率调整，而智能体则整合观测数据和个人历史来选择剂量、碳水化合物摄入和设备操作。 这些轨迹展示了可调节输注如何跟随延长的吸收过程和不断变化的胰岛素需求（图4）。 这些案例表明，给药配置会影响控制性能，并支持了高频闭环控制与低频智能体决策相结合的潜力。

paragraphs.en: We test the effects of information and decision frequency in Infusion-Site Leakage and Mixed-Intensity Exercise. Each scenario crosses three information levels with fixed intervals of 15, 30, 60, and 120 minutes, giving 24 runs of 72 hours each with the same extra-decision allowance. At a fixed 60-minute interval, moving from I2 to I0 raises COGI by 43.2 points on leakage and 15.7 on exercise (Table 6 ). Under I2, shortening the interval from 120 to 15 minutes adds 10.5 and 3.7 points, respectively. Averaged over both scenarios and all information levels, input-token use at 15 minutes is about 4.2 times that at 60 minutes. In these two cases, added context yields larger gains than increasing frequency alone. Frequent decisions partly compensate for missing information but require more computation. Together with the CL-on/off results and the interval sweep for OpenAPS (Appendix C.2 ), this supports using frequent background control alongside an agent that makes informed, less frequent decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在「输注部位渗漏」和「混合强度运动」两个场景中检验信息与决策频率的影响。 每个场景将三个信息级别与 15、30、60、120 分钟的固定间隔交叉组合，共得到 24 次运行，每次运行时长为 72 小时，且额外决策许可相同。 在固定的 60 分钟间隔下，从 I2 降至 I0 使渗漏场景的 COGI 上升 43.2 分，运动场景上升 15.7 分（表 6）。 在 I2 下，将间隔从 120 分钟缩短到 15 分钟分别增加 10.5 分和 3.7 分。 在两个场景和所有信息级别上取平均，15 分钟间隔的输入 token 用量约为 60 分钟间隔的 4.2 倍。 在这两种情况下，增加上下文带来的收益大于仅提高决策频率。 频繁决策可以部分弥补信息缺失，但需要更多计算。 结合 CL 开/关的实验结果以及 OpenAPS 的间隔扫描（附录 C.2），这支持在高频后台控制的同时，配合一个做出知情但频率较低的决策的智能体。

paragraphs.en: In C04, a 39-year-old woman skips breakfast and lunch and exercises repeatedly for long periods before a late meal, so hypoglycemia is a constant risk. APC scores 85.06 against 77.73 for OpenAPS ( + 7.33 +7.33 ). Its time in 4–8 mmol/L is 84.14%, slightly below OpenAPS’s 85.42%, but its time below 70 mg/dL is 2.55%, compared with 6.13% for OpenAPS. Figure 5 marks three decisions. At marker 1 (10.58 h), a meter check confirms a low of 67 mg/dL and the agent gives 12 g of fast carbohydrate. As glucose keeps falling with little insulin recorded as active, the agent’s rationale raises the possibility of unreported exercise, and it responds with carbohydrate and temporary basal reductions that it can later reverse. At marker 2 (58 h), its record of low glucose in the late morning on the two previous days leads it to lower the temporary basal rate to 20% early, and it adds carbohydrate at 58.42 and 58.58 h as glucose continues to drop. At marker 3 (68 h), having seen a strong fall after an earlier correction, it gives only 0.7 U, and when glucose falls faster than it predicted, it lowers basal delivery again. In this episode the agent checks the sensor against the meter, revises its explanation when the response does not match, and carries lessons from earlier days into later doses.
paragraphs.zh: 在 C04 中，一位 39 岁的女性不吃早餐和午餐，并在较晚进餐前反复长时间运动，因此低血糖始终是一个风险。 APC 得分为 85.06，而 OpenAPS 为 77.73（+7.33 +7.33）。 其 4–8 mmol/L 范围内的时间为 84.14%，略低于 OpenAPS 的 85.42%，但其低于 70 mg/dL 的时间为 2.55%，而 OpenAPS 为 6.13%。 图 5 标出了三个决策点。 在标记 1 处（10.58 小时），血糖仪检测确认低血糖为 67 mg/dL，智能体给予 12 克快效碳水化合物。 由于血糖持续下降而记录的活动胰岛素很少，智能体的推理提出可能存在未报告的运动，并以碳水化合物和暂时性基础率降低作为响应，这些调整可在之后撤销。 在标记 2 处（58 小时），基于前两天上午晚些时候低血糖的记录，智能体提前将暂时性基础率降至 20%，并在 58.42 和 58.58 小时随着血糖继续下降追加碳水化合物。 在标记 3 处（68 小时），由于观察到此前一次校正后血糖大幅下降，智能体仅给予 0.7 单位；当血糖下降速度快于其预测时，它再次降低基础率输注。 在这一情节中，智能体用血糖仪核对传感器，在响应与预期不符时修正其解释，并将前几天的经验带入后续的剂量决策。

paragraphs.en: In F06, a 9-year-old girl misses breakfast after a meal bolus and then exercises while a positive sensor bias masks the fall in true glucose. APC scores 72.75 against 48.52 for OpenAPS ( + 24.22 +24.22 ). Time in 4–8 mmol/L is 68.52% versus 57.18%, and time below 70 mg/dL is 3.47% versus 11.00%. Figure 6 highlights three decisions. At marker 1 (10 h), calibration gives a meter reading of 50 mg/dL when CGM had read about 94; the agent gives 12 g of fast carbohydrate five minutes later and checks again. At marker 2 (34 h), it explicitly recalls the earlier positive bias and obtains a meter reading of 51 despite CGM near 91. It gives 15 g and confirms a rise to 86 mg/dL fifteen minutes later. At marker 3 (55.08 h), its rationale cites the lows on both earlier mornings and starts a two-hour temporary basal rate at 20% before the recurring decline. Lows still occur and require further carbohydrate rescue. This case shows how the agent can combine repeated meter checks with saved experience to adjust earlier and reduce hypoglycemia.
paragraphs.zh: 在 F06 中，一名9岁女孩在餐后大剂量输注后未进早餐，随后进行运动，而传感器正偏置掩盖了真实血糖的下降。 APC 得分为 72.75，而 OpenAPS 为 48.52（+24.22）。 4–8 mmol/L 范围内的时间为 68.52%，对比 57.18%；低于 70 mg/dL 的时间为 3.47%，对比 11.00%。 图6重点展示了三个决策。 在标记1处（10小时），校准时血糖仪读数为 50 mg/dL，而 CGM 此前读数约为 94；智能体在五分钟后给予 12 克快速碳水化合物并再次检测。 在标记2处（34小时），智能体明确回忆起之前的正偏置，并在 CGM 读数接近 91 时测得血糖仪读数为 51。 它给予 15 克碳水化合物，并在十五分钟后确认血糖升至 86 mg/dL。 在标记3处（55.08小时），其理由引用了之前两个早晨的低血糖情况，并在周期性血糖下降开始前启动了持续两小时、剂量为 20% 的临时基础率。 低血糖仍会发生，需要进一步的碳水化合物补救。 该案例表明，智能体能够将反复的血糖仪检测与保存的经验相结合，从而更早地进行调整并减少低血糖的发生。

paragraphs.en: In E04, an adolescent girl has recurring infusion-site leakage and intermittent positive sensor drift. APC scores 47.37 against 66.20 for OpenAPS ( − 18.83 -18.83 ), with 10.65% of the time in 4–8 mmol/L and no true glucose below 70 mg/dL, so the deficit comes from persistent hyperglycemia and high variability. Near marker 1 in Figure 7 , the agent uses meter checks and calibration to detect the sensor disagreement, but it repeatedly attributes the weak response to insulin to unreported food or changing insulin needs. It changes the infusion set at 13 h (marker 2), about 12.75 h after the leak began, and the saved simulator state confirms that effective delivery then recovers from 15% to 100%. When the leak returns near 24.17 h and 48.33 h, however, it does not change the set again. At marker 3 (50 h), with CGM at its upper display limit, it gives another 2.5 U. Over the episode it requests 60 boluses, of which 59 are delivered and one is rejected by the minimum-interval rule, and it changes the set only once. paragraphs.en: Insulin continues to act after delivery, making dose history and reassessment timing central to physiological control ( Holt et al., 2021 ) . paragraphs.en: We introduce DiabAgent , comprising the APC framework, the DiabetSim simulator, and the SweetBench benchmark. APC links agent decisions to medical-device actions and applies this control loop to glucose management in type 1 diabetes. DiabetSim provides virtual testing across patients, events, devices, and observation conditions. SweetBench turns this environment into 212 tasks for evaluating the physiological outcomes of agent decisions. Together, these components establish a reproducible research setting for agentic physiological control. We hope DiabAgent provides a foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control and supports extending this research to other physiological systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍 DiabAgent，它由 APC 框架、DiabetSim 模拟器和 SweetBench 基准测试组成。 APC 将智能体的决策与医疗设备的动作联系起来，并将这一控制回路应用于 1 型糖尿病的血糖管理。 DiabetSim 提供跨患者、事件、设备和观测条件的虚拟测试。 SweetBench 将这一环境转化为 212 个任务，用于评估智能体决策的生理结果。 这些组件共同为智能体化生理控制建立了一个可复现的研究环境。 我们希望 DiabAgent 能为智能体参与人体生理控制奠定基础，并支持将这一研究扩展到其他生理系统。

sents.zh: 我们介绍 DiabAgent，它由 APC 框架、DiabetSim 模拟器和 SweetBench 基准测试组成。

sents.en: APC links agent decisions to medical-device actions and applies this control loop to glucose management in type 1 diabetes.
sents.zh: APC 将智能体的决策与医疗设备的动作联系起来，并将这一控制回路应用于 1 型糖尿病的血糖管理。

sents.en: DiabetSim provides virtual testing across patients, events, devices, and observation conditions.
sents.zh: DiabetSim 提供跨患者、事件、设备和观测条件的虚拟测试。

sents.en: SweetBench turns this environment into 212 tasks for evaluating the physiological outcomes of agent decisions.
sents.zh: SweetBench 将这一环境转化为 212 个任务，用于评估智能体决策的生理结果。

sents.en: Together, these components establish a reproducible research setting for agentic physiological control.
sents.zh: 这些组件共同为智能体化生理控制建立了一个可复现的研究环境。

sents.en: We hope DiabAgent provides a foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control and supports extending this research to other physiological systems.
sents.zh: 我们希望 DiabAgent 能为智能体参与人体生理控制奠定基础，并支持将这一研究扩展到其他生理系统。

paragraphs.en: The main evaluation uses Dana-i, insulin aspart, and real-time CGM for 72-hour episodes under I2. The agent decides every 60 minutes with at most six event-triggered decisions per local day. The shared prompt supplies the COGI-4-8 objective, personal therapy settings, device limits, and available information. It prefers 5–6 mmol/L when safely achievable; the scoring band remains 4–8 mmol/L. Each decision executes one environment action. Personal notes persist within an episode and reset between tasks. All model backends request high reasoning effort. Table 11 lists the model harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 主要评估在 I2 条件下使用 Dana-i、门冬胰岛素以及实时连续血糖监测（CGM），每次评估时长为 72 小时。 智能体每 60 分钟决策一次，每个本地日内最多有六次事件触发的决策。 共享提示词提供 COGI-4-8 目标、个人治疗设置、设备限制以及可用信息。 在可安全实现的情况下，目标优先设定为 5–6 mmol/L；评分区间仍为 4–8 mmol/L。 每次决策执行一个环境动作。 个人笔记在一个回合内持续保留，并在不同任务之间重置。 所有模型后端均请求高推理强度。 表 11 列出了各模型的运行框架。

paragraphs.en: We implement BB with a prescribed basal schedule and a bolus calculator ( Holt et al., 2021 ; Fox et al., 2020 ) . The calculator returns u = max ⁡ ( 0 , f ​ C / C ​ R + q ) u=\max(0,fC/CR+q) , where C C is reported carbohydrate intake, C ​ R CR is the carbohydrate ratio, and f = 1 f=1 for BB. Let c = ( G − G target ) / I ​ S ​ F c=(G-G_{\mathrm{target}})/ISF , where G G is observed glucose and I ​ S ​ F ISF is insulin sensitivity. The correction term is q = max ⁡ ( 0 , c − I ​ O ​ B ) q=\max(0,c-IOB) for c > 0 c>0 and q = c q=c otherwise; I ​ O ​ B IOB denotes nonnegative bolus insulin on board, with total insulin on board as a fallback. Dose rounding, device limits, and minimum bolus intervals constrain execution. BB also includes low-glucose treatment and responses to explicit device prompts. Our BB+Rules extension adjusts f f , incorporates CGM trends into G G , and adds predefined rules for exercise, illness, temporary basal changes, and device maintenance ( Riddell et al., 2017 ) . Both use only visible reports and records, with 15-minute consultation intervals in the main evaluation. Meal boluses require an available meal report.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用一个预设的基础率方案和一个大剂量计算器来实现 BB（Holt et al., 2021；Fox et al., 2020）。 该计算器返回 u = max(0, fC/CR+q)，其中 C 是报告的碳水化合物摄入量，CR 是碳水化合物比率，BB 中 f = 1。 设 c = (G − G_target)/ISF，其中 G 是观测血糖，ISF 是胰岛素敏感系数。 当 c > 0 时，校正项为 q = max(0, c − IOB)，否则 q = c；IOB 表示体内非负的大剂量胰岛素，若不可用则以体内胰岛素总量作为回退。 剂量取整、设备限制和最小大剂量间隔会约束执行。 BB 还包括低血糖处理和对明确设备提示的响应。 我们的 BB+Rules 扩展调整 f，将 CGM 趋势纳入 G，并增加了针对运动、疾病、临时基础率变化和设备维护的预定义规则（Riddell et al., 2017）。 两者都只使用可见的报告和记录，在主评估中咨询间隔为 15 分钟。 进餐大剂量需要有可用的进餐报告。

paragraphs.en: Our OpenAPS baseline uses the oref1 algorithm with npm release 0.7.1 of the official OpenAPS repository, https://github.com/openaps/oref0 , and its MIT-licensed dosing core ( OpenAPS community, 2026 ) , with super-micro-boluses (SMB) and unannounced-meal (UAM) prediction enabled. Our adapter constructs inputs from visible CGM, delivery records, personal therapy parameters, and carbohydrate estimates, and enforces device limits. UAM deviation slopes and sensitivity adaptation use approximate implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 OpenAPS 基线采用官方 OpenAPS 仓库（https://github.com/openaps/oref0）npm 发布版本 0.7.1 的 oref1 算法，及其采用 MIT 许可证的给药核心（OpenAPS 社区，2026），并启用了超微大剂量（SMB）和未声明餐（UAM）预测。 我们的适配器从可见的动态血糖监测（CGM）数据、输注记录、个人治疗参数和碳水化合物估计值构建输入，并强制执行设备限制。 UAM 偏差斜率和敏感性自适应采用近似实现。

paragraphs.en: HCL denotes the default DASH background controller: DASH-w/ CL enables it and DASH-w/o CL disables it. This software layer follows public closed-loop designs and integrates the OpenAPS core to adjust basal delivery when new CGM readings arrive ( OpenAPS community, 2026 ) . The agent retains its decision schedule and selects doses, carbohydrate intake, and device actions; an agent-set temporary basal takes priority until expiry or cancellation. The standalone reference runs the same closed-loop implementation every five minutes under matching DASH/Fiasp, patient, seed, event, and CGM conditions, with rule-based sensor maintenance and no agent.
paragraphs.zh: HCL 表示默认的 DASH 后台控制器：DASH-w/ CL 启用它，DASH-w/o CL 禁用它。 该软件层遵循公开的闭环设计，并集成 OpenAPS 核心以在新 CGM 读数到达时调整基础率输注（OpenAPS 社区，2026）。 智能体保留其决策计划并选择剂量、碳水化合物摄入和设备操作；智能体设置的临时基础率在到期或取消前具有优先权。 该独立参考实现在匹配的 DASH/Fiasp、患者、随机种子、事件和 CGM 条件下，每五分钟运行一次相同的闭环实现，采用基于规则的传感器维护且不含智能体。
